_note: Demo seed for the public Syracuse switchgear RFP. Quotes are verbatim from the PDF; page, lines and highlight boxes are computed by the anchoring code. Unit responses are ILLUSTRATIVE, not real SpinCo answers.

requirements.quote: One (1) 15kV two (2) section Metal Clad Switchgear lineup.
requirements.text: Supply one 15 kV, two-section metal-clad switchgear lineup.

response.response: Two-section 15 kV arc-resistant metal-clad lineup offered.

requirements.text: Supply the protective relays and controls.

response.response: Relay and protection panels engineered to the one-line diagram; relay schedule confirmed at design review.

requirements.quote: BIDDER shall provide a schedule for the project with the bid. This shall indicate, at a minimum, the schedule for drawings, shipment from factory, delivery at site, overall lead time to site ARO, and schedule for field works.
requirements.text: Submit a project schedule with the bid: drawings, factory shipment, site delivery, lead time ARO, field works.

response.response: Consolidated schedule from unit inputs attached to the bid.

requirements.quote: In addition to other Submittal requirements, final drawings shall be submitted as AutoCAD format files.
requirements.text: Final drawings must be submitted as AutoCAD files.

requirements.quote: Metal Clad Switchgear shall have eighteen (18) 15kV vacuum circuit breaker positions with protective relay and controls, two (2) revenue meter positions, two sets of (2) 15kV isolation switches, bus VT's, and multi-ratio CT's as shown in Contract Documents.
requirements.text: 18 x 15 kV vacuum breaker positions with relays, 2 revenue meter positions, 2 sets of isolation switches, bus VTs and multi-ratio CTs.

response.response: Lineup configured with 18 breaker positions, 2 revenue metering compartments and isolation switches.

requirements.quote: Switchgear shall be Arc-resistant Type 2B. The switchgear shall meet or exceed the most conservative interpretation of standard IEEE C37.20.7.
requirements.text: Arc-resistant Type 2B switchgear meeting IEEE C37.20.7 (most conservative interpretation).

response.response: Type 2B arc-resistant construction, tested to IEEE C37.20.7.

requirements.quote: Metal Clad Switchgear shall be mounted within a fully enclosed Equipment Building (by others).
requirements.text: Switchgear is installed inside an equipment building supplied by others.

response.response: Building is by others. An EP² control building could be offered as an alternate.
response.reason: The equipment building is supplied by others under this RFP, not by the switchgear supplier.
response.workaround: Offer an EP² control building as an alternate.

requirements.quote: Separate utility incoming Cable termination compartment is required, that allows the utility to lock.
requirements.text: Provide a separate, utility-lockable incoming cable termination compartment.

requirements.quote: Each phase shall have 1 inch diameter ground ball.
The MANUFACTURER shall provide a NEMA four-hole pad and insulating boots for incoming and outgoing cable connection of up to two (2) 750 MCM 15kV cables, per phase.
requirements.text: NEMA four-hole pads and insulating boots for up to two 750 MCM 15 kV cables per phase.

requirements.quote: Furnish two (2) bus Sections with tie breaker to contain the equipment specified in Contract Documents.
requirements.text: Two bus sections with a tie breaker.

requirements.quote: Furnish relays, controls and associated accessories and hardware as required for a complete functional and operational system.
requirements.text: Furnish all relays, controls and hardware for a complete, working system.

requirements.text: Proposal due by email by 15 Sep 2023, 4:00 PM.
